title: Broncos WR Pat Bryant: I felt a nudge, sold enough to get the pass interference call

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos WR Pat Bryant: I felt a nudge, sold enough to get the pass interference call
sources.description: The accuracy of the pass interference call that set the Broncos up for the winning touchdown over the Rams in last Sunday night's game has been debated around the football world, but what's not in debate is that Broncos wideout Pat Bryant did all he could to ensure a flag was thrown.
